name: restate_rule
description: Record, in your own words, exactly what the rule claims and does not claim.

rule_summary.description: A one-sentence restatement of the rule.

name: examine_cards
description: Acknowledge that you have examined the visible face of all four cards.

reviewed.description: Set to true once you have read all four visible faces.

name: note_disproof
description: Record the single observation that, if found on a card's hidden side, would prove the rule FALSE.

falsifying_observation.description: What hidden value, on which visible card, would break the rule.

name: select_cards
description: Record the single combination of cards you will turn over to test the rule.

selection.description: The combination of cards to turn over.
